root_idea.summary: The root centers on an edge, extremity, or verge, especially the brink of danger.
root_idea.development: From the notion of reaching an edge or boundary, the evidence extends to being near destruction and to a small remnant. The related healing noun شِفَاءٌ is explained as reaching the edge of safety, developing into recovery, treatment, and remedy.

senses.definition: Edge, brink, or verge of something.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quranic construction عَلَى شَفَا + genitive, expressing being at the edge or brink of a thing, especially a perilous situation such as a pit or collapsing bank.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the sun: to set, or to become near to setting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression قُبَيْلَ الشَّفَا refers to a little before sunset.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the moon: to rise; of a person or visible form: to appear or become apparent.
To restore a sick person to health or convalescence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Takes a person as object, commonly with مِنْ مَرَضِهِ, from his illness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To relieve someone from doubt; figuratively, to satisfy or please by what one says.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use connected with relief from an unresolved question or inner distress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek, request, or desire recovery for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative or supplicatory use distinct from directly restoring the person to health.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat someone medically or curatively with whatever may bring recovery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is treated by comprehensive or suitable medical means.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To increase or profit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported substituted usage, described as originally belonging to شَفَّفَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become on the brink or verge of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually associated with an evil or danger, though it may also be used of something good; the expression شَفَا اللَّيْلِ denotes its final part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become at the point of giving or receiving a charge, injunction, trust, or deposit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction describing the threshold of undertaking or entrusting something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a medicinal remedy or prescribe a treatment intended to restore health.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The remedy may be specified as something provided to enable recovery.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative use without the specifically medicinal sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To obtain relief or satisfaction from anger, especially by injuring an enemy or attaining what one seeks against him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The anger is treated metaphorically as an illness from which one recovers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exhaust or use up water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported expression تَشَافَيْتُ المَاءَ is identified as originally تَشَافَفْتُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attain recovery or convalescence by means of something; to become free from illness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Commonly used with بِـ to indicate the means by which recovery is attained, or with مِنْ for freedom from a disease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find satisfaction, relief from doubt, or benefit in something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe being reassured by truthful information or profiting from it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or request a remedy or cure.
A little, small portion, or small remainder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of what remains of the moon, daylight, sunlight, sight, life, or another quantity; it may also denote a final remnant or the last part of a period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Recovery from disease; restoration to health or convalescence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The primary nominal sense of becoming free from illness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Medical or curative treatment; the giving of health.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extension from recovery itself to the treatment that produces it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A medicine or remedy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used figuratively for a means of remedying an incapacity, such as asking for information.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Recovering, restorative, remedial, or health-giving.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective describing something that restores health or promotes recovery.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relieving doubt or providing a satisfying resolution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figuratively used of an answer that removes uncertainty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most remedial or health-giving.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or elative adjective derived from the health-giving sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose lips do not close together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical adjective; feminine شَفْيَاءُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An awl or similar instrument for perforating and sewing leather, especially footwear or water-skins.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may be masculine or feminine and has plural أَشَافٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sharp in the elbow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative expression, إِشْفَى المِرْفَقِ.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The temporal verge expression is covered by the broader brink/verge meaning.
The self-directed construction is covered by the broader brink/verge meaning.
The edge/brink meaning is Quran-attested and represented by the public form sense.
Morphological note and pointer to another article; no new lexical branch.
The figurative remedy example adds no separate lexical branch.
Illustrative saying only; it adds no lexical meaning beyond the awl.

cautions: No Maqayis entry matched this root; the root-level development is therefore based on the supplied Mufradat discussion.
The QAC group attests شَفَا only. Related healing forms such as شِفَاءٌ are broader Classical Arabic evidence here, not additional occurrences of this Quranic form.
